name: @seekdaseek/plugin-agentfeed
description: Crypto market data for AI agents (liquidations, funding, open interest, prices), Solana pre-trade checks, OFAC sanctions screening, scholarly papers, x402 endpoint checks, claim checks against sources, site signals, utilities and fixed-purpose language tasks (OCR, translate, summarize, extract, classify, prompt-injection check, transcribe). An elizaOS plugin for AgentFeed: 91 paid data routes and 1 free one as actions, $0.001–$1 per call in USDC over x402 on Solana, no API keys.

AGENTFEED_PRIVATE_KEY.description: Solana private key of the paying wallet (base58 string OR JSON byte array). Wallet must hold USDC on Solana mainnet. Fund with $1 of USDC = ~100-1000 calls.

AGENTFEED_BASE_URL.description: AgentFeed API base URL. Default: https://x402.ochinimus.app

AGENTFEED_MAX_SPEND_PER_CALL.description: Safety cap in USD per single API call. Any 402 quote above this is refused. Default: 0.5, which allows every action except the most expensive, get_x402_test ($1); set 1 or more to allow it. Lower it to restrict spend.
